content: Mbǝ ki Yal ki Mbatl ki Lya
Nǝ cinkǝ penticos mbǝ u, kummwasǝn mi'kushti asi gelu kǝnǝmi.
Sige nǝgu i kum otiluwon sullya, kǝnǝ mbǝ' ki bal yetǝl, i mbǝ i ikǝn libi u nǝ siki dǝmi giɓi u.
I uliyen kǝnǝ lǝga ki bǝlǝn utu i bwasi tya tǝn gawasǝn.
Kummwasǝn is ikǝn nǝ Yal ki batl ki Lya is gop shilǝn nǝ unndi biyen nǝ Yal ki batl ki Lya bǝlsi u.
Yahudawa yen ɗa mi' bǝtl zhil ki Musa, asi ki dǝmi a Ulushelima, nǝs pete'ge atlen ki dǝplǝɓa.
Nǝs kum o'tilu u, i dopga ki mbalǝn mani, ilu hwodǝli, tǝngaki kowonngi ɗǝ kupsi asi shilǝn nǝ bishilǝnwasǝn.
Iki is kum gagashinti, asi usu, “Mi' Galili ɗǝ shilǝn u waiwa?
Ya lakiɗa musinǝn mi kupsi ɗǝ shilǝn nǝ bi inǝn?
Mingu paltiyawani nǝ Madiyana nǝ Elamawa, mi' dǝp ki atl ki Bagadaza, nǝ ki Yahudiya nǝ ki Kapadokiya, nǝ ki Pantas nǝ ki Asiya,
nǝ ki Pilijiya, nǝ ki Bampiliya, nǝ ki Masal, nǝ kuma yanki Kulane ki atl ki Libiya nǝ sǝmbǝlsi te' Loma, wato mi ginǝ zǝmi ge' bǝtl Lya ki Yahudawa, nǝ mbalǝnyi nǝ tege' bǝtl Lya undi ki Yahudawa u,
nǝ Kalitawa nǝ Lalabawa, mus mi kupsi ɗǝ shilǝn ki bas lǝɓa ki Lya nǝ bi kige' gatlinǝn.”
Mus is kum gagashinti, is hwoɗǝli, is gop gyep yelsǝni, “Yakǝn ngu?”
I gyen, ngayisi shilǝn is usu, “Mal ki innabi si tle iye.”
I Bitlus Shilǝn nǝ Mbalǝn Diɓǝli
Iki i Bitlus hilya nǝ kutl nǝ nǝm mi, i' tlǝl Yal i' shilǝn nǝ diɓǝl mbalǝn, i' usu, “Yelsǝni ini Yahudawa nǝ mus mi' dǝp a Ulshelima, hwe ta pikin shilǝn u; gakǝn kǝm ki zeki tǝn ulnǝ ta dlǝmi u.
Mbalǝn yi sǝ tle mal ki innabiwai, kan u nǝki zitini uwai, nǝgun dom ki nǝtapsi katl kinǝkyau!
Guki ulnǝ Joyel mul nje shinkǝn ki Lya shilǝn tǝnki u ti usu:

content.text: “ ‘Age pa'ti ki dǝp lǝɓa, Lya usu,
anbine' mus mbalǝn Yal ki mbatl ki Lya suɗi.
Millwakǝn mwani nǝ mudli sǝn shilǝnti nǝ ndǝtl ki Lya,
tlu'ti nǝn mbi mil giɗǝnsiwakǝn,
kolsiwakǝn sǝn tlu'ti.
Nǝguɗa, ge' muttu
zhelsi ini mwani nǝ mudli anbine'si Yal ki mbatl ki Lya suɗi
sǝn shilǝnti nǝ ndǝtl ki Lya ɗaɗanu.
Anpǝli'si ulki gagashinti a lya,
nǝ lwaɗi su'atli,
iki hwula, nǝ utu, nǝ hillya ki cil.
Kapǝn mbǝ ki Mulban balcin mul naltu,
cin nǝ patl dǝpshal
lyi nǝn patl hwula.
Age' cin u nǝn dǝmti mus mulnǝ
mbe' shin ki Lya u tǝn mbi pe'ti.’ ”

content: “Kini yelsǝni ini Isla'ilawa gakǝn kǝm tǝn shilǝn u: Yesu mul Nazalat gunǝ Lya kǝni ma'kini tu tǝn, pǝl ulki ki gagashinti, nǝ ulki ngaptibi nǝ lwaɗi, gunǝ Lya pǝli ge' kini tumati, gunǝn yeninini nǝ dwaɗǝwakǝn u.
Mul gu, Lya nǝ gawasi ti bǝlkinti a toh wakǝn nǝ kan u nǝs zi nǝ mantiwasi nǝ ndǝ'twasi, kini nǝ ɗǝlki mil bezǝn lǝɓa, ki tolinti tǝn gadlǝnnga i' tloti.
Ngonǝ nǝgu i Lya tlǝlti ɗǝ ge' mi'mǝshti, tǝngaki mushti aman ngaptiwai. Lya tlǝlti ɗǝ ge' mi'mǝshti, tǝngaki mushti aman ngaptiwai.
Dauda shilǝn tǝnti i' usu:

content.text: “ ‘Ko gaswukǝni Mulban akina ini,
ti tǝn toh shimtini,
tǝn gaki ɓa wuni.
Tǝngaki nǝgu mbatlini ɗǝ hwoltugi,
lǝga ini ɗǝ utl ulki hwoltugi,
dli ini nǝn dǝmti nǝ lati mbatli,
tǝngaki nǝgu tikǝn zati dli ini age zuɗiwai,
ki kǝn zati mulguntwagi apɓoswai.
Tǝn la'ti aman shitu ki mbadli.
Tǝn ikǝntǝn nǝ hwoltugi akinawasi.’

content: “Yelsǝni ini Isla'ila, amma' pi'kin shilǝn bǝnǝ catl mbadlwai atǝn bwas ki bwasinǝn Dawuda. Dawuda ta mǝci, akupti. Zuɗiwasi ama'mini hal nǝguni.
Amma ti mul njeshinkǝn ki Lya kǝni timanini Lya apǝli' ndǝ'ti nǝ ndaltannaca, tǝn zǝ'nǝm ge' gǝswasi tǝn guntwasi.
Tun teɗi Dawuda a yenini, i' shilǝni tǝn hillya ki Almasihu ɗǝ ge' mi' mǝshti, tǝkǝn zatiti age zuɗiwai, dliwas kǝn ɓostwai.
I Lya tlilti Yesu ɗǝ ge mi' mǝshti, mussinǝn ɗaɗanu mi' yenti nǝ dwaɗǝn kǝni.
Ngo nǝnǝgu a nalti tǝn tohship ki Lya i, ta nje Yal ki mbatl ki zoki mul gunti ma bwasi, kan u nǝppǝl ndǝ'ti, tin bina' Yal ki mbatl ki Lya tǝn ga inǝn, i mbǝl ulnǝ yenini u nǝ ulnǝ kumini u.
Dawuda tolyawai, tinǝ gawasi, i' usu,

content.text: “ ‘Mulban ul mulban isu,
“dǝm a tohshimtini,
Sai nǝ ala' mi'ngeki agǝs asǝn wagi.” ’
Tǝn gaki nǝgu, mus Isla'ila sǝnmanica Yesu u nǝ' tolti tǝn gadlǝnnga u, Lya apalti mulban nǝ Almasihu.”
Nǝ mbalǝn kumi nǝgu u, i shilǝnisi tǝnisi mbadli, is ul Bitlus nǝ na mi'shinkǝn usu, “Yelsǝni, yakǝn tǝn pǝlini?”
I Bitlus pisi, “Zakǝn pǝtl bezǝn lǝɓa a pǝlikin Batisma, kowonngi, ge' shinki Yesu Almasihu tǝn ti' paci kin bezǝn lǝɓawakǝnɗa. Kǝn mbi bǝlti ki Yal ki mbatl ki Lya ki zoki.
Ndǝ'tu kini pǝli kini nǝ milwakǝn nǝ ginǝ lolu, nǝ mus ginǝ mulban Lya nǝn mbessibi u.”
Nǝ shilǝn mul diɓǝtl kǝn ti dǝlisi kǝm; i' matisi, “Pekǝlǝn gawakǝn ɗǝge' besǝn hwon ki nǝguni.”
Ginǝ kum shilǝn u ipǝlisi Batisma, ge'cin u mbalǝn zangu maki mbǝltǝnsi.

content: Dǝp ki mi'bǝtl Yesu kal
Is ga'kǝm, tǝn kushti ki mi' shinkǝn ɗǝ pǝlti u, asi ma'ga nǝ yelsǝni, asi ɗamti gelu kǝnǝmi, asi shilǝn nǝ Lya.
Is kum ɓanti, nǝ ulki gagashin nǝ lwaɗi nǝ Lya pǝli ma mi' shinkǝn u.
Mus mi'bǝtl Yesu si ge'lu kǝnǝmi mus lǝɓawasǝn ge'lu kǝnǝmi.
Is ul lǝɓawasǝn taka nǝ nisiɗa u asi bwasi' yelsǝni wasǝn ulpisi ginǝ bǝnisi ɗawai u tǝn lyamtiwasǝn.
Ko gasiwukǝni si dopga age' libi ki Lya nǝ mbatl nǝm. Asi ɗap ulki ɗami a libiwasǝn ge'lu kǝnǝmi, si ɗapti asi tleti nǝ hwoltugi, nǝ ndǝti ki mbatli.
Is dǝmshot si ngep Lya asi mbi hwol hwula ma mbalǝn. Ko cin u kǝni a Lya ɗǝ mbǝl diɓǝltwasǝn tǝnki ginǝs pe'tu.
